CadAssistance.heading: Don't have a CAD file? We'll draw it for you.
CadAssistance.subheading: Send a sketch, a photo, or just the dimensions over WhatsApp — our team returns a manufacturing-ready CAD file you can quote and produce right away.
CadAssistance.step1Copy: A hand sketch, a photo of the part, or a list of dimensions — straight over WhatsApp.
CadAssistance.step2Copy: Our team turns it into a manufacturing-ready STEP/IGES file within 48 hours.
CadAssistance.step3Copy: Use the file to get a quote and put the part into production — all in one place.
CadAssistance.tier3Desc: From a physical sample or broken part

HowItWorks.heading: From upload to delivery.
HowItWorks.intro: Every order follows the same clear path — you send a design, we handle the rest.
HowItWorks.step1Copy: Send us your STL, STEP, DXF, or IGES file with quantity, material, and any notes.
HowItWorks.step2Copy: We identify the right process for your part — 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, or EDM.
HowItWorks.step3Copy: We route the job to a vetted partner workshop and track it through production.
HowItWorks.step4Copy: Your finished part is quality-checked and delivered back to you.

About.heading: Manufacturing, made simple in Qatar.
About.lead: Gestaltung for Trading and Services is a manufacturing marketplace and inventory platform based in Lusail, Qatar.
About.body1: We connect clients who need parts made with the network of skilled workshops that can make them. You send a design; we match it to the right production method and a capable Qatari workshop, then manage the job through to delivery.
About.body2: Alongside custom manufacturing, we run a store for high-quality mechanical parts and a multi-tenant inventory system that keeps every workshop's and client's data cleanly separated.
About.value1Copy: The right method for every part, not a one-size-fits-all process.
About.value2Copy: Vetted workshops across Qatar, coordinated in one place.
About.value3Copy: Track every job and every item from one bilingual dashboard.
